lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.purpose: Durable user intent for track recording, not confirmation that a service or track row exists; cleared after confirmed Stop from map/menu/notification commits. BootLoader and MainActivity auto-resume TrackerService when true. Toolbar and service read it in the default application process so a delayed Start cannot overtake Stop. Map GPS callbacks use this flag to request asynchronous track rendering without a main-thread SQLite unfinished-track query.
